_comment: Loud burned-in captions for the tiktok-raw format: 1080x1920, one to three words a card, Montserrat ExtraBold, heavy outline, positioned above TikTok's own bottom UI and left of its action rail. Designed to be read at arm's length on a phone in daylight.
_usage: vedit/captions.py: build_ass(words, project, preset). Values under 'ass_style' are ASS field names and go straight through. Keys beginning with '_' are documentation and MUST be ignored.
name: tiktok-bold
_comment_play_res: PlayResX/PlayResY MUST equal the render resolution. Otherwise libass scales and width_budget_px stops being pixels.

font._comment: Montserrat-ExtraBold.ttf reports nameID 1 = 'Montserrat ExtraBold' (typographic family 16/17 = Montserrat/ExtraBold). Fontname must be the nameID 1 string with Bold=0; 'Montserrat' + Bold=-1 is ambiguous and can resolve to Montserrat-Bold or to a faux-bold Arial, silently, exit 0.

ass_style._comment: Colours are ASS &HAABBGGRR - reversed byte order, alpha 00 = fully opaque. Outline 7 at 76 px is deliberately heavy: on a busy handheld background a 3 px outline disappears.
ass_style.Name: Default

_comment_margins: Straight out of platforms.tiktok.caption_safe_area_pct at 1080x1920: MarginL 5 % = 54, MarginR 20 % = 216 for the like/comment/share rail, MarginV 24 % = 461 to clear the username, the caption text and the nav bar. Note 24 %, not the 22 % of the graphic safe area - a burned-in caption has to clear the platform's OWN caption text, which sits above the nav bar. The asymmetric L/R margins are load-bearing: with Alignment 2 libass centres within (MarginL, PlayResX - MarginR), so the text centre lands at x=459 rather than 540, pushed clear of the rail. That offset is intentional, not a mistake.

position._comment: Bottom-anchored via Alignment 2 plus MarginV. The hook graphic owns the top of the frame - see presets/formats/tiktok-raw.json.

grouping._comment: PIXEL-width budget, never max_chars - German compound nouns are single unsplittable tokens. Cards are short because the highlight is doing the pacing: three words is a beat, seven is a paragraph nobody reads.
grouping._comment_clause: Clause punctuation does not force a break here. At four words a card, commas would fragment the line into ones and twos and the captions would strobe.

overflow._comment: 810 px at 76 px Montserrat ExtraBold is roughly 17-19 characters. Any decent German compound noun exceeds that on its own, so this is the normal path, not the exception.

highlight._comment: Per-word highlight as separate Dialogue events, not \k karaoke: \k requires the whole line as one event and quantises to centiseconds, which puts the highlight up to half a frame off. Separate events land on exact frames and survive a later re-cut.
highlight._comment_carry: The highlight holds 40 ms past the word end so it does not flicker off during the gap before the next word.

_comment_uppercase: All caps. Montserrat ExtraBold at 76 px in caps reads at a glance; mixed case at four words a card looks like a subtitle rather than a beat. German nouns are capitalised anyway, so caps cost less semantic signal here than they would in English.
_comment_punctuation: Terminal full stops and commas are dropped entirely - on a one-word card they are visual noise. ? and ! are kept.
